literature_scope.role: Bhadra–Schweinberger v2 Condition 1 and equation (3.2) provide the full-assignment identification argument under ignorability and consistency. Aronow–Samii and Hudgens–Halloran provide design and treatment-strategy context.
limitations: The project checks positive design probability for the specified assignment and A4 node-level conditional means for that assignment. The all-assignment positivity condition in the v3 comparison is broader than this support check.
A fixed-quota design can exclude the target assignment. The project contract separately specifies the certificate and finite-mixture requirements.
The project contract also lists Sävje. Its role relative to this mapping's source list remains to be reconciled.
